environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2, behind a basic Network Load Balancer (NLB, Layer 4 only). The Flask app runs as the 'reportgen' user with standard Linux permissions. No application-layer proxy or filtering is applied. The NLB passes TCP traffic directly to port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0. No SELinux or AppArmor profiles are enforced (permissive mode). The container/host has sed, pdflatex, pandoc installed.
